details:
There's several pages which inconsistently state the minimum system requirements for storage to be 1.5 GB, 21.5 GB, or 30 GB. This seems to be unintended, and may be a source of confusion.

https://help.vrchat.com/hc/en-us/articles/1500002378722-System-Requirements

> Storage 21.5GB (~1.5GB for application, remaining for content cache)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/438100/VRChat/

> Storage: 1 GB available space

https://docs.vrchat.com/docs/configuration-file#size-and-expiry-time

> You can adjust both of these settings using the following configuration options. Please note that the values cannot be adjusted below their default values.

> `cache_size`: Valid Values: Greater than or equal to `30` [GB]

All of these should be corrected to ~31.5 GB, in my opinion. (App + cache) This seems somewhat correct, because [SteamDB reports the app depot to be 1.02 GiB](https://steamdb.info/app/438100/depots/?branch=public), and the content cache needs to be a minimum of 30 GB configured. (The storage requirement is currently reported to be even less on standalone mobile, [~807.86 MB](https://www.meta.com/en-gb/experiences/vrchat/1856672347794301/).)
title: Inconsistent or mixed statements about minimum system requirements for storage (app + cache)
